indexPrompt.mlp-four-lines-cut-the-plane: A hidden layer's four ReLU units switch on along four lines in the input plane, with no parallel pair and no three through one point. How many regions do the four lines cut the plane into?
indexPrompt.mlp-max-by-hand: Every network below is one hidden layer of ReLU units feeding a plain weighted sum, and the weights are chosen by hand. Build the two units that output the absolute value of x, build the four units that output the larger of a and b, and show that no single unit can output x itself.
indexPrompt.mlp-relu-on-a-regression-output: A regression network ends with a linear layer and then a ReLU, and part of the training set has targets below zero. What does the final ReLU do to the predictions and to the gradient?
indexPrompt.mlp-square-by-sawtooth: The tent t(x) = 2 ReLU(x) − 4 ReLU(x − 1/2) climbs from t(0) = 0 to t(1/2) = 1 and comes back down to t(1) = 0. Feeding it into itself gives a sawtooth, and the piecewise-linear interpolant of x² is x minus a sum of scaled sawtooths.
indexPrompt.mlp-ten-layers-with-no-activation: Ten nn.Linear layers are stacked with no activation function between any two of them. Which family of functions can the whole stack compute?
indexPrompt.mlp-xor-linear-impossible: XOR of two bits is 1 when exactly one of them is 1. The question is whether some choice of w1, w2 and b turns a classifier with no hidden layer into XOR on the four inputs.
